summary: NeoGenomics filed an 8-K announcing the pricing of a $275 million (plus $41.25 million greenshoe) 0.75% convertible senior notes due 2032, offered via Rule 144A to QIBs. The notes are senior unsecured, interest payable semiannually, maturing July 1, 2032. Conversion rights apply under certain circumstances before April 1, 2032, and freely thereafter. The offering is expected to close on June 22, 2026. The proceeds likely support general corporate purposes or capital returns, though not explicitly stated. Watch for conversion mechanics and potential dilution; risk-arb focus on note pricing and market reception.
